criteria.notes: The reviewed matrix proves a searchable three-level directory, highlight fallback, same-floor routing, and both cross-floor route segments.
The redraw preserves the source building proportions, public spine, department adjacency, and aligned vertical core without exposing construction-sheet clutter.
The civic plan language, continuous corridor, restrained department zoning, floor controls, and route details form a specific wayfinding product rather than a generic dashboard.
Primary labels, route actions, current position, destination marker, and route summary remain legible at both accepted near-view kiosk surfaces.
Light, dark, and custom palettes keep text, controls, route lines, corridor surfaces, and destination feedback distinct.
Long titles and destination names retain complete text, the level badge remains a stable single-line pill, and the directory stays scrollable.
Full-HD and compact compositions preserve the map-directory hierarchy, usable touch targets, explicit floor controls, and stable details without overlap.
The semantic SVG, civic icon, route-focused placeholder, editor palette, and selected-state treatments are coherent and production-ready.
The floor-plan composition and explicit circulation model are structurally distinct from card, feed, poster, and raster-map examples.
